page.overview:
Who is The Vulture?

The Vulture was a town Fremen who married a sietch Fremen named Felicity. She was killed in an attack by the Sardaukar while attempting to defend children. Losing her broke him and he continued to speak to her as if she were alive.

The Vulture was approached by the Prisoner in an abandoned alleyway in Arrakeen. He introduced them to Felicity, apologising for her silence. They pointed out that there was nobody there and he replied that it hurt Felicity's feelings. Angered by their rudeness, he told them to state their business or leave. They told him that they were seeking the Jackal and he told them that he would only speak to those who knew the words. He told them that Felicity knew the word and he presented a riddle on her behalf. They correctly answered that the word was "silence", for which he commended them. He told them that it was an old Fremen riddle that she had learned when she lived among them. The Prisoner asked if Felicity knew what happened to the Fremen and he told her of how she was killed. He admitted that he knew it was insane, but found solace in keeping the one he loved. He told them that the word they were looking for was "worm".
